 The Columbus Blue Jackets (5-5-0) and Carolina Hurricanes (10-2-2) will meet in the NHL tonight. Puck drop is set for 7:00 p.m. EDT at Lenovo Center in Raleigh, N.C. The game will be broadcast live on ESPN+.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Hurricanes are favored at -255 on the moneyline, with the Blue Jackets +205 to pull off the upset. The over/under is set at 6.5 (+106o / -130u).
 Let's get into our Blue Jackets vs. Hurricanes predictions and NHL picks .
 Blue Jackets vs. Hurricanes Prediction
 Pick: Under 6.5 (-130) 
 Our Columbus vs. Carolina best bet is on the under total goal, with the best odds currently available at FanDuel. For all of your NHL bets, be sure to find the best lines by using our live NHL odds page. 
 Make sure to download the Action Network app for more NHL picks and analysis! 
 Blue Jackets vs Hurricanes Odds
 Blue Jackets vs. Hurricanes puck line: Hurricanes -1.5 (-104), Blue Jackets +1.5 (-120)
 Blue Jackets vs. Hurricanes over/under: 6.5 (+106o / -130u)
 Blue Jackets vs. Hurricanes moneyline: Blue Jackets +205, Hurricanes -255
 Blue Jackets vs. Hurricanes best bet: Under 6.5 
 The Blue Jackets (5-5-0) have won two in a row, knocking off the Golden Knights and Flyers . But this is still a team that is averaging only 2.5 goals per game, which is 28th in the NHL. That's what makes this spot against the Hurricanes (10-2-2) so tough.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Carolina has been on fire lately, going 8-1-1 in their last 10 games. They have allowed a combined one goal in their last two. Facing a Blue Jackets team that has a tough time finding the back of the net, this feels like another low-scoring game.
 The Canes are allowing the fewest shots on goal in the NHL, making this look like the ideal game environment for Under 6.5.
 Best Bet: Under 6.5 (-130)
